author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: QuickSearch registers a global shortcut listener that is unreachable in the current mount path.
findings.consequence: The component carries a second shortcut implementation that does no useful work in the current app and can drift from the guarded shell shortcut policy for modifiers, contenteditable targets, and open dialogs.
findings.evidence: The owned mount callback adds `onGlobalKeydown` at line 376. Source search found the current component mount only in `app/components/global/SiteShell.vue` as `<LazyQuickSearch v-if="quickSearchOpen" initially-open />`; `SiteShell.vue` opens it and adds `modal-open` before mount. With `initiallyOpen`, `isOpen` is already true when this listener is installed, so `onGlobalKeydown` returns at line 257 and cannot call `open()`. The actual production shortcut is already handled by `SiteShell.vue` through `isProductionShortcutGuarded`.
findings.recommendation: Delete the QuickSearch-owned global keydown registration and its private `onGlobalKeydown`/`open` path once the unused internal trigger branch is removed, keeping shortcut ownership in `SiteShell.vue`. If standalone mounting is still required, reuse the same `isProductionShortcutGuarded` policy instead of this local listener.
